description: Return one page of the pracht documentation as Markdown, or only one section of it. `page` accepts a path (/docs/capabilities), a slug (capabilities, recipes/auth), or a page URL. A whole-page read lists the page's anchors in `sections`. An unknown page or section answers found: false with the closest matches.

page.description: Page path, slug, or URL, e.g. /docs/capabilities.

section.description: Heading anchor from docs_search or `sections`, e.g. remote-mcp-tools-for-agents-without-a-browser. Empty or omitted reads the whole page.

name: docs_read
title: Read a pracht docs page
